name: Stealth Jammer - Crit DMG
RelatedDescription: This advanced optics system can distort light, allowing ST fitted with this backpack model to become somewhat invisible. Also integrates a function that affects the enemy's Crit DMG capability.

61248.name: Invisibility Device I · Crit DMG
61248.SpecificEffects:
At the end of the action, if there are no enemies within the adjacent (<color=#F74848>2</color> tiles) area, gain <buf ID=3004502>[Stealth I]</buf> with a trigger interval of <color=#F74848>3</color> turns.
In combat, the enemy's Crit DMG <color=#F74848>-10%</color>.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
